message:
Partial refunds now come out at the right amount, and `npm test` passes (20 of 20).

The bug was in `src/payments/partial-refund.js`. The function treats `percent` as 0–100, but it multiplied the amount by `percent` directly, so a 50% refund came out as 50 times the payment. I changed it to divide by 100, so a 50% refund on 1250 now gives 625. I touched no other files.
